title: Respect label availability in a temporal split
description: Repair a temporal evaluation split that trains on labels unavailable at the historical cutoff.

checks.test_delayed_label_is_not_training_data: Labels unavailable at the cutoff are excluded from training
checks.test_offsets_are_compared_by_instant: Timestamps with offsets are compared by their actual instant
checks.test_input_order_and_values_are_preserve: The split preserves input order and values
